surface_mechanism_description: Dechlorosilylation reactions between BiCl3 and (Et3Si)2Se precursors
evidence: An atomic layer deposition (ALD) process was developed for an important thermoelectric material Bi2Se3 utilizing dechlorosilylation reactions between BiCl3 and (Et3Si)2Se precursors. The applicability of this alkylsilyl selenide precursor was confirmed, as reactions with BiCl3 produced good quality thin films with low impurity contents.
